items.topic: Custom Signup object, record per submission
items.statement: Per Gemini notes, Kobi proposed a custom Signup object where every form submission creates a new record that reps work directly (not the Player object), with validation only when a signup is linked to a contact, to avoid deduplication and validation failures. Marc agreed. Internal Jumpr discussion only; no client confirmation.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran proposed utilizing a custom signup object where every form submission generates a new record, allowing representatives to manage these records directly rather than interacting with the player object. By performing validation only when a signup is linked to a contact record, the team can avoid deduplication issues and validation failures during initial signups. Marc Cabantog agreed with this approach
items.supersedes_hint: Replaces the Lead object approach in the PRD (internal proposal).
